scope: One first actual compiled Moriarty swap on public Preview: deploy, initialize, swap, close. No loan replay, retry campaign, local-chain execution or recompile.
draftDeadline: deadlineMs=0 deliberately fails production validation; only admitted execution may materialize deadline from the observed independent timer epoch.

privatePreparation.walletPersistence: Continue the original Preview wallet from its three current snapshots persisted by the actual loan run. Retain that loan backup untouched; the new swap allocation creates its own exclusive backup and pending marker. Interrupted persistence blocks future launches; no automatic rollback or marker removal.

timeSeconds.scope: All bootstrap build/runtime/genesis checks, private setup, wallet restore/sync, proofs, submissions and finalized readbacks share operation deadline; no independent per-stage allowances. No restart when a substage exhausts remaining time.

launcherService.RuntimeMaxSecRule: floor(remaining operation seconds)+6, resolved immediately before launch; also bounded by independent shutdown
launcherService.TimeoutStartSecRule: floor(activation deadline minus current monotonic time)-1; require >=1, fsync resolved argv, then require remaining time >= this allowance before systemd-run

retain: all partial public evidence and reservations
containment.stopOnAmbiguity: UNKNOWN; retain all charges; no replay, resubmission, new wallet, state rollback or automatic recovery

proofAccounting.sourceObservation: The integration runs four logical stages; providers.mjs constructs the SDK httpClientProofProvider without a proof-callback counter. Wallet finalization is inside the bounded provider reservation path. Four is the intended stage/finalize sequence, not an independently enforced aggregate SDK proof request limit.
proofAccounting.sdkInternalRetries: SDK callback multiplicity and internal retries are not established as an absolute count. All consume the same wall time, CPU, memory, DUST and submission ceilings; no new allowance or retry campaign.
proofAccounting.enforcedAccounting: The provider checks reservedSubmissions < 4 plus cumulative DUST and gross native asset allowance before reservation; these enforced financial caps are unchanged.

networkBounds.walletAndIndexerRateLimit: No new QPS limiter is claimed. Existing SDK transport/polling under one process and shared wall deadline; no extra diagnostic polling loop.
networkBounds.proofReadiness: Existing TCP-listener readiness pattern only: at most 30 loopback connect samples to 127.0.0.1:16300, at least 1s between samples, <=2s/connect inside the 120s setup window. Listening does not prove proof correctness or asset readiness.

storage.scope: Four logical native submissions retained by existing byte writer; preserve all copies, original/new wallet snapshots, new contract store and partial results. No private bytes or raw SDK output published.

privateDiagnostics.creation: Exclusive O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW, mode0600, fsync files and owner0700 directory before acknowledged manager activation.
privateDiagnostics.retention: Do not publish raw SDK logs. Hashes and narrowly sanitized excerpts require separate inspection/review. Preserve full original private files on failure.
privateDiagnostics.scope: Finite process runtime and CPU bound log production but do not establish a numeric byte ceiling. The 4GiB free-disk precheck is headroom, not a quota. No RLIMIT_FSIZE is applied because it would also cap wallet snapshots, native payloads and private LevelDB files. Disk exhaustion stops the attempt; retain original logs and reservations, no automatic truncation or replay.

priorCharges.preservation: All earlier local/Preview hello-world, build/compiler, proof, failed preflight, permission amendment, probe/runtime and reviewer charges remain consumed, including the loan preflight failure with no new wallet operation. This is not a global fee total or a refund/reset. Prior loan raw FAILED/INCOMPLETE remains separate from all four compared stages and observed outer containment.
